title: Chapter 1488 - 610: Public Deliberation
content:
Chapter 1488: Chapter 610: Public Deliberation

Ning Zhuo continued his analysis: "The treasures from Flowing Gold Guest’s second battle have too obvious an origin. The Alarm Whistle, Thousand Weight Plunge, Thunder Breaking Pearl, Breakup Blade Talisman, and Golden Stone Opening Skill—all make one associate with forces on Flowing Cloud Peak. There’s no need to state it explicitly, just let everyone know that before Nanming Village even truly ascends the mountain, Flowing Cloud Peak is already afraid."

Sun Lingtong nodded repeatedly.

He listened with increasing expectation for the enemy’s response.

Ning Zhuo now backed by Nanming Village, has considerably more room for action.

Currently, Flowing Gold Guest has become his pawn. Ning Zhuo and the Nanming Village side, are contending against numerous major forces on Flowing Cloud Peak, engaging in a strategic remote contest centered around Flowing Gold Guest.

Obviously, this is unfair to the various forces on Flowing Cloud Peak.

Due to the Golden Liquid Returning Pill Body’s innate talent, the use of divine sense is restricted, making it difficult for Flowing Cloud Peak’s side to aid effectively, rendering most of its strength unable to be fully utilized.

A battle often emphasizes the right timing, geographical advantage, and human harmony.

Ning Zhuo exploited the opportunity provided by the Nanming Fire Furnace, and cleverly established Nanming Village, thereby gaining a certain measure of timing.

He utilizes Flowing Gold Guest as a pawn, essentially holding a significant "geographical advantage." The Flowing Cloud Peak side is forced to continue under this disadvantageous environment and even increase support for Flowing Gold Guest.

Flowing Gold Guest is the "challenge letter" that Ning Zhuo has presented!

As for human harmony, both sides are somewhat evenly matched. There are numerous factions on Flowing Cloud Peak, and each keeps a wary eye on the others. It’s rare for them to join forces to oppose Nanming Village, but the degree of cooperation is limited.

The establishment of Nanming Village is opportunistic, with many internal divisions among members, maintained only by the identity layer of the debtor. Not to mention the coexistence of humans and demons, there are also deep-set grudges between some members!

Don’t be fooled by Nanming Village boasting five Nascent Soul level entities, including numerous Golden Core level cultivators, in reality, it is strong on the outside but hollow within, extremely weak, with scattered hearts, unable to effectively concentrate power.

"I have fought Flowing Gold Guest twice, consecutively severing the enemy’s head." Ning Zhuo’s gaze turned distant, "The time is ripe, it’s time to convene the members of our Nanming Village once more."

Sun Lingtong departs, while Ning Zhuo widely spreads a flying message.

Before long, Nanming Village’s cultivators gathered in Ning Zhuo’s Cave Mansion.

Facing the crowd, Ning Zhuo did not waste words.

He placed the Alarm Whistle, Thousand Weight Plunge, Thunder Breaking Pearl, Breakup Blade Talisman, and the Jade Scroll Copy of the Golden Stone Opening Skill one by one before the crowd.

These items are not just spoils, but also evidence!

The Alarm Whistle originates from the Bird and Beast Manor, the Thousand Weight Plunge carries the Earth Veins Law of the Territorial Expansion Alliance, the Thunder Breaking Pearl slightly resembles the Tribulation Thunder of the Thunder Cloud Association, the Breakup Blade Talisman closely resembles the Sword Intent Rune Path of the Broken Water Blade Pavilion, and the Golden Stone Opening Skill is undeniably linked to the Golden Stone Alliance. As for the Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo, any discerning eye could tell it’s not something Flowing Gold Guest, merely a loose cultivator, could easily acquire.

Flowing Gold Guest’s second battle was no longer a solo fight.

Flowing Cloud Peak’s forces handed the sword to him, hence when Nanming Village strikes back, it’s justified.

"This indeed saves trouble." The Red Robe Guest grinned at the spoils, a murderous smile lurking beneath his humor, "They’ve presented the evidence right before us, if we don’t take it, wouldn’t that be a shame for their efforts?"

Chun Yangzi’s demeanor was clean and solemn: "Retaliation is possible, but must be approached rationally. Nanming Village was just founded, and it’s within the Wanxiang Sect’s Main Mountain Gate, drawing myriad attention, so our conduct must prioritize justification. The support for Flowing Gold Guest from Flowing Cloud Peak’s forces could be grounds for accountability, but not as a pretext for reckless warfare."

The Red Robe Guest sneered: "Such woman’s kindness! When the knife is at the throat, should we still ask if there’s a name carved on the hilt?"

Chun Yangzi stared at him: "Without justification, it’s private conflict. With justification, it’s accountability. The difference between the two is vast."

"Justification?" The Red Robe Guest scoffed, "Isn’t the justification right on the table? Alarm Whistle, Thousand Weight Plunge, Thunder Breaking Pearl, aren’t these their tails? What I see as most appropriate is to conclude today’s meeting, visit them tomorrow. Whoever sent the treasure, go seek an explanation from them. If no explanation is given, then fight!"

Chun Yangzi and the Red Robe Guest locked eyes, neither yielding.

The others couldn’t help but feel a headache approaching.

Nanming Village has yet to act externally, fearing there might be internal strife first.

On the brink of conflict, Shen Xi suddenly spoke: "If I remember correctly, Chun Yangzi is the Great Village Chief of the first chair, correct?"

He clearly stood by Chun Yangzi.

Upon these words, Chun Yangzi glanced at him approvingly, nodding slightly, while the Red Robe Guest merely cast a cold glance.

Shen Xi remained unmoved.

He represented a super family’s Foundation Establishment, having such a powerful backing, he wasn’t afraid of antagonizing a Nascent Soul.

The Red Robe Guest suddenly stood up: "Listen to Chun Yangzi? Not a chance! A group dallying around, how can anything be accomplished? Watch me go kill the enemy’s arrogance first! Also, let you all know, despite Flowing Cloud Peak appearing strong, it’s riddled with internal strife, ultimately not worth worrying about!"

After finishing his statement, the Red Robe Guest stood up, flicked his sleeves, and left Ning Zhuo’s Cave Mansion directly.

In the hall, the crowd faced each other in perplexity.

The discussion had barely started, and a Nascent Soul level powerhouse had already been agitated away.

Many eyes turned to Chun Yangzi, who remained expressionless, while some instinctively looked towards Ning Zhuo.

Ning Zhuo surprisingly smiled, surveying around: "Do any fellow Daoists have different opinions?"

As the words fell, the Nine Fire Dragon Lord spoke.

"The foundation of Nanming Village has always been the Nanming Fire Furnace."

"How the Flowing Cloud Peak forces provoke can be settled slowly. But the last twenty percent of the furnace is incomplete and cannot be delayed any longer. After all, the sooner the furnace is fully restored, the sooner Nanming Village will have the capacity to repay its debt, while also being able to suppress human hearts!"
